name: lingdt-decision-1.0
description:
LingDT-Decision (4B version) is an in-house System One model developed by Ant Digital Technologies, available for testing and evaluation with a default per-user rate limit of 60 RPM. For production workloads, users can use the LingDT-1.1 series. The model is designed for decision-making tasks across the software development lifecycle. LingDT-Decision-1.0 natively supports multi-choice (multiple selection) and extract (information extraction).

During the free-access period, the model supports up to 16K context per request, up to 32 questions per request, a DAG depth of 3, and a maximum of 255 options. Information extraction supports up to 96 slot definitions per question.
API Guide：maas.antdigital.com/docs/lingdt-decision-api-guide
